title: ethereal woman with dog
description: A woman with pale skin, blue eyes, and mosaic patterns on her face looks upward from the center of the image. Her hands are not visible touching anything while a grey dog in a ruffled collar and armor stands beside her on a cracked reflective surface that shows their reflections below.
